title: Elf Bar Elfx Mega Pod Vape Kit
description: The Elf Bar ELFX Mega Vape Kit is a category-defining device that combines the portability of a pod system with the endurance of a box mod. Engineered for vapers who demand longevity, it is powered by a colossal 2800mAh integrated battery—one of the largest in its class—capable of delivering up to 14 days of usage on a single charge in ECO mode. Under the hood, the ELFX Mega introduces Elf Bar’s latest QUAQ DURA coil technology. This advanced dual-mesh design not only delivers intense flavour but reinforces the coil structure to last up to three times longer than standard pods. The device offers a max output of 32W, controlled via two distinct modes: "Turbo" for maximum vapour and flavour intensity, and "ECO" for efficiency and extended battery life. The sleek aluminium alloy chassis features a 0.96-inch OLED screen that provides real-time data on wattage, puff count, and battery status. A side-mounted airflow slider allows for precise transitions between a tight Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw and a loose Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vape. Paired with the exclusive side-fill ELFX Mega pods, this kit is the ultimate workhorse for daily vaping. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
